# Tables for: How the four models differ on a pulse

Statistic: the paired **mean** response per Gt of the pulsed gas, 2030 pulse, MAGICC's 5 reportable markers (vvLN and vvML are lost whole to its sub-pre-industrial Greenland defect). `[SAME-STATISTIC]` verified: the cross-model and duration tables are the same numbers to float rounding. FACTS has no row in T3-T5: it was not run through the annual-path extractor, so no duration statistic exists for it -- an ABSENCE, not a zero.

## T2 — the CH4:CO2e exchange rate at 2300 (GWP100 = 29.8)

| model | per-marker (like-for-like) | per-species median | CO2 rank | CH4 rank |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| MAGICC-SLR | **0.618** | 0.637 | 1 of 3 | 3 of 3 |

Spread across the three primary models: **1.76x** per-marker, 1.61x on the per-species median. The rank reversal and the spread survive both aggregations; the climate-share percentages do not. FACTS is ranked separately because it is a workflow family, not a fourth peer -- both of its pulse-valid workflows sit below all three on both species.
